title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Hugh Carlson is the Chief Executive Officer of Three Crowns. Since joining the firm at its launch in 2014, he has helped build it from a small boutique into one of the world’s premier dispute resolution practices. He also serves as the firm’s General Counsel. Hugh places special emphasis on innovation, informed by his background […]
